name: s1_mirror
feel: drone pad, voice declamatory and gloating; the old king is shown his reflection and his fall

name: s2_portrait
feel: longest stanza, darker pad, longer pauses (73-85 s); portrait of fear as it was: whips, beast, the guest with blood

name: s3_mercy
feel: voice softens, slower; pity and generosity toward the tired old man, the mother's fear

name: s4_mirrors
feel: resolve: fear dressed up for the children, we are your mirrors, the abyss, the ring-closing first line; pad swells 161-164 s and ends 166.4 s
